title: Freight Claim Exception Report
subtitle: Freight Claim Intake: preserves facts, evidence, and actions.
description: Freight Claim Exception Report covers claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation. The freight claims coordinator records Freight Claim Intake chronology, evidence, containment, and effectiveness. Freight Claim Exception Report keeps Freight Claim Intake exceptions visible until the freight claims coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Freight Claim Exception Report at origin, transit custody points, destination, inspection location, and evidence repository. Document claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation identity before Freight Claim Intake begins. Compare claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation findings with stated Freight Claim Intake criteria; route unresolved Freight Claim Intake issues to authorized claims reviewer. For Freight Claim Exception Report, confirm requirements for Freight Claim Intake. Ask authorized claims reviewer to review Freight Claim Intake conditions beyond the freight claims coordinator's role.

sections.title: Freight Claim Intake incident details
sections.guidance: Record when the issue was discovered, who reported it, the exact affected subject, and the initial condition.

sections.title: Affected scope, evidence, and escalation
sections.guidance: Preserve volatile evidence, distinguish affected from unaffected scope, and keep required notifications visible.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without control
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when claim identity, determinable amount, evidence preservation, notice, or authorized investigation remains unresolved. Protect claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation; document the Freight Claim Intake notification and await authorized claims reviewer direction.

blocks.label: Evidence preserved or linked
items: Bill, invoice, packing, and delivery documents
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation; mark only Freight Claim Intake evidence present in that record.

items: Loss, damage, delay, or expense allegation
Mitigation, salvage, repair, and retained goods
Notice, document completeness, and investigation owner
blocks.guidance: Record what was checked without converting an allegation, inference, or unavailable fact into an observation.

blocks.label: Severity, notification, and escalation triggers
items: Intake treated as liability or payment decision
blocks.guidance: For Freight Claim Intake, identify affected claimed shipment, affected goods, loss amount, supporting documents, mitigation, and investigation scope; ask freight claims coordinator to document the Freight Claim Intake immediate control before continuing.

sections.title: Corrective action, disposition, and review
sections.guidance: Track containment through disposition and an effectiveness check; do not close an incident merely because the immediate event stopped.
